findings.F1: In a choppy market (60-day return between -10 % and +10 %), the coin's 30-day return points the way of its next 7 days in a graded way on both sides: from the lowest to the highest quintile of the 30-day return, the 7-day move beyond the coin's normal drift is -12.9 % (t -1.85, 15 cases, 7 days), -5.6 % (t -1.99, 17 cases), +0.4 % (45 cases), +5.1 % (t 1.23, 24 cases) and +10.8 % (t 1.81, 8 cases). Outside chop the quintiles show no order (+0.7 %, -3.9 %, -0.9 %, +4.0 %, +0.3 %).
findings.F2: Scaled by the coin's own 30-day swing, the same order holds in chop over 7 days: the lowest tercile is -8.4 % (t -1.73, 29 cases, 15 days), the middle -1.4 % (55 cases) and the highest +10.2 % (t 2.44, 25 cases, 9 days). In falling markets the terciles show no order (-1.2 %, -0.8 %, +5.1 %, all t below 1.2), and in rising markets only the lowest tercile stands out (-14.6 %, 9 cases).
findings.F3: Over the tested 21-day horizon, the order breaks down in chop: the scaled terciles give -12.4 % (7 cases), +28.2 % (10 cases) and +10.0 % (11 cases), none with t above 1.3. Over the whole book the 30-day return and the next 21 days correlate at -0.06. The week, not three weeks, carries the continuation.
findings.F4: The tested short-only book could not pay. The coins drifted upward by 3.70 % per 21 days against the short, which left a total move of +0.14 % per case against a trade cost of 0.22 %. The book was in the profile on only 4.6 % of bars. On its position days, the deepest-fall tercile earned +0.04 % a day, below the middle tercile's +0.37 %, so convex depth did not help.
findings.F5: A day in the bottom fifth of the coin's own swing-scaled daily moves is followed by a next-day excess gain of +0.62 % (t 2.14, 1,487 cases, 412 days). The gain is positive in 11 of 12 windows and in all four years. This is the fall-rebound already held many times in the profile map, so it is not a discovery.
findings.F6: Daily excess returns by weekday are negative on Wednesday (-0.44 %, t -2.60) and positive on Thursday (+0.32 %, t 2.25) and Friday (+0.37 %, t 2.85). With seven groups and the many angles looked at, this is close to chance, and the late-week gain is already held (045-01).

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the further a coin's 30-day return sits from zero, measured against its own swing over those 30 days, the further it moves the same way over the next 7 days: up after a strong month, down after a weak one, more for a larger month.
ideas.consequence: A trader in a trendless coin trades with its month's move over the following week, long after strong months and short after weak ones, and does not hold the bet for three weeks.
ideas.name: choppy scaled month week continuation
